title: Agnus Dei (Hesdin, Missa Benedicta es)
desc: Nicolle des Celliers de Hesdin, Missa Benedicta es, Agnus Dei, c. 1535-1537. 6 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Sextus, Tenor, Quintus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0029_5); edited by Christina Cassia, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
